rule: Base names are icons/*.svg with the -12/-16/-24/-48/-96 size suffix stripped (647 files -> 332 names). Style variants (-fill/-filled, accessibility-inset; 21) and feed-* activity variants (19) inherit their parent glyph's classification, leaving 292 distinct concepts. Class a (GitHub domain concept): the glyph's primary job on github.com is to name a GitHub object, product, or object state with an API/object model - repositories, git objects, pull requests, issues, projects, discussions, Actions, packages, security features, apps, accounts/teams, sponsors, gist, wiki, notifications, codespaces, copilot. Class b (UI chrome): navigation, layout, generic verbs and editing controls. Class c (other): file-type glyphs, markdown formatting, reactions, and brand-neutral miscellany. Only class a enters the hit-rate denominator; family groups state variants under one concept.
